documents.title: BP Process Overview — Manual Entry Hotspots
documents.excerpt: Every step of the business planning process involves manual data entry or adjustments. Actuals re-keyed from BW E0P; volume and price assumptions exchanged by email and Excel.

documents.title: F&C Workshop Munich — Unified Data Platform
documents.excerpt: Workshop with ~30 F&C stakeholders: ACDOCA access, real-time P&L, Material Ledger, Cortex Analyst on finance data. SAC remains the planning frontend.

documents.title: Manufacturing Footprint — Rzeszów Ramp-up Plan
documents.excerpt: Floorcare and small-appliance volumes transfer from German sites to Rzeszów. Ramp-up curve 3 months ahead of plan; under-absorption risk concentrated in H1.

documents.title: Material Ledger Actual Cost — Q3 Close
documents.excerpt: Electronics (Home Connect modules) 4% above standard cost; steel and resins stabilising. Variance visible per material and plant within 24 hours of close.

documents.title: European MDA Market Outlook 2026
documents.excerpt: European major domestic appliance market flat to +1% after two years of decline. Premium built-in recovering faster; entry segment pressured by Asian competitors.

documents.title: US Tariff Pass-through — Competitor Price Moves
documents.excerpt: Wolf and Miele raised US list prices 6–9%. Thermador and Bosch Benchmark show low elasticity; recommend aligned price step in Q1.

documents.title: China Trade-in Subsidy Taper
documents.excerpt: National appliance trade-in subsidy expected to taper in H2 2026. Domestic brands intensifying price competition in multi-door refrigeration.

documents.title: Turkey & India Laundry Share Gains
documents.excerpt: Profilo and Bosch front-loaders gaining share in Turkey and India; Çerkezköy and Chennai capacity unconstrained. TRY-adjusted price increases landed.

documents.title: Retail POS — Cordless Vacuum Sell-out
documents.excerpt: Bosch Unlimited cordless sell-out +11% YoY in DACH; Black Friday pre-orders ahead of last year at major electronics retailers.

documents.title: BW E0P Decommissioning Roadmap
documents.excerpt: BW E0P reporting to be replaced by a unified data platform; Datasphere zero-copy from S/4HANA as the actuals source for planning and real-time P&L.
